appCreator: Nothing changes in an app today: no module ships an agent yet. A module's skills and agents now install with pack add, update with harness-sync and go with pack remove, also in an app that is still in discovery.

If a module's skill or agent has the same name as one the app wrote itself, pack add copies nothing and says which name to change; harness-sync and the health check say the same if the clash arrives with a later update, and never overwrite the app's own.

Removing a pack now also removes the folders it leaves empty, so a removed module no longer leaves an empty skill folder that the health check reports, and the backlog tool stops treating a removed roadmap module as present.

New decisions are recorded with decisions.mjs, which takes the next free D-NNN across every branch, so two parallel threads can no longer pick the same id; prd-intake points apps at it. Health notes a decision id used twice and only fails 14 days after the app's install or first sync (the lock now records that date).

Running studio-sync check or health no longer changes git config or Claude settings: if the safety hooks are off they say so and name 'studio-sync.mjs hooks'. Hooks still turn on at session start, on pull, install and pack, and with 'hooks'.
Nothing changes in an app until it adds the module (pack add research). It can be added at any time, also before a stack is chosen, and is meant to stay for the app's whole life.

With the module, a request to research, check, size or compare something before a product decision runs as a study: the pass and fail rules are fixed and committed before any search, evidence against is searched as hard as evidence for, every source is graded and quoted, and an independent skeptic agent re-checks the sources and forms its own verdict before you get the result.

One skill covers every kind of study; the rules for a user reality check, a market size, a competitor scan, a competitive analysis and the use of an outside research tool are loaded only when that kind is asked for.

When you run an outside research tool yourself, paste its text back (not a share link). Sources nobody on the study opened carry no weight unless you accept them, and then they stay labelled "accepted, not opened" in every summary.
Study ids (R-001, R-002, ...) and the rows of docs/research/studies.md come from a script, so two threads never take the same id.
The skeptic runs on a strong model at high effort: a standard study costs one such agent run, a deep study one more.

Nothing changes in an app until it adds the module (pack add discovery, which also brings the research module). It is meant for a new product idea, before a stack is chosen, and for removal once building starts; the documents it produced stay.

With the module, discovery has a method: one document at a time, by interview (one question at a time, each with a recommended answer): the product foundation, personas checked against research evidence, success metrics, constraints and non-goals, then the MVP and roadmap, written so they turn into the PRD and backlog later.

You can ask for the riskiest hypotheses (ranked, each with a cheap test), for a throwaway clickable prototype that says what it can and cannot prove, for three different design directions after a rejected prototype, and for an architecture handoff that a separate agent on a strong model reviews before you see it.
Asking where discovery stands gives a scored report of nine exit criteria and the next steps. It only reports: building starts when you say "start building".

A short Discovery profile in the app's CLAUDE.md holds the product facts the skills read, and your sign-off mode: approve each document (the default), or let documents merge on their own with a record you can ask a recap of.
The handoff review costs one agent run on a strong model at high effort.

Every session of an app in discovery starts by saying how many exit criteria are done and which document is next.

The plan's own commit on main is what proves the pass and fail rules were fixed before the search. Before, a study merged as one squashed commit lost that proof, and the skill never said how a study gets to main at all.
The skeptic agent now checks that order on main, and that the plan changed afterwards only in its Deviations section.
An app that added discovery after it already had a stack no longer fails its first check when a prototype is saved as an HTML file.
A thread in your app can no longer commit or push to app-studio by changing folder inside the command; before, that form slipped past the lock.
